1.name: Trail of the Missing
1.overview: Jodi Larsen recently joined the National Park Service Police after a year marked by the loss of her mother and her decision to leave the military after serving her final tour of duty. She unexpectedly teams up with a dog named Blue as her new partner. Together, they tackle their first case, investigating the disappearance of a boy who went missing while camping with his family. As night falls, a race against time begins to find the boy before it's too late. Both Blue and Jodi are put to the ultimate test.

1.name: Fugitive in the Wild
1.overview: When a fugitive goes missing in the National Park, Jodi must work with a U.S. Marshal to find the man and bring him to justice. As the case unfolds, Jodi realizes there is more to this fugitive than she's been told, leading to a shocking discovery and an epic chase to find the fugitive and solve the case.

1.name: Body in the Woods
1.overview: Blue discovers a body in the woods with no ID and no clear cause of death. With mounting evidence pointing in different directions, Jodi must navigate a web of secrets and hidden motives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious death.

1.name: The Fall
1.overview: During a bungee jump excursion a man dies when the bungee line snaps. With a number of suspects, Jodi and her team discover there is more to this case than meets the eye.

1.name: Shadows of the Pack
1.overview: When a protected wolf and her pups go missing in the forests of Crystal Ridge, Jodi and the NPS team are thrust into action, needing to find them and discover why they went missing before it's too late.

1.name: Edge of Deception
1.overview: A social media influencer is live streaming on the edge of a cliff when she suddenly falls. While searching, Blue is injured and with his life now on the line, it's a race against time to save them both.

1.name: The Last Coordinates
1.overview: A treasure hunt in the park leads to a dead body; Bill finds himself in a life and death situation.

1.name: Whispering Pines
1.overview: Bill is deliberately run off the road and severely injured; uncovering a targeted attack.

2.name: Send Off
2.overview: An energy drink company's, gruelling no-limits endurance mountain bike race comes into the heart of the park. When a top contender turns up dead, the investigation exposes a cutthroat world where survival isn't the only thing at stake.

2.name: Open Frequency
2.overview: A big rig is hijacked along a desolate highway bordering the park and authorities uncover a communication system allowing the hijackers to move undetected. The race is on when its discovered that the drivers's daughter was inside the rig.

2.name: The Botanist
2.overview: When a podcaster is found dead on a remote trail, Nora recognizes unsettling similarities to a serial killer named The Botanist, reviving fears that a long-dormant serial killer may be active again.

2.name: The Hunt
2.overview: A young boy goes missing during a Bigfoot event in the park. As the team scrambles to find him, some clues point to the creature itself, and others point to something more sinister at play.

2.name: Exiled
2.overview: A body found in the park is connected to stolen Native American artifacts. The NPS is assisted by the tribal police who suspect an exiled tribe member. Tracing his steps as he disappears in the park, the team discovers more at play.

2.name: Yoga in the Woods
2.overview: At a secluded wellness retreat, a woman is found dead in a sauna. As the investigation unfolds, a web of hidden motives among the seemingly enlightened guests come to light, revealing a murder more calculated than anyone imagined.

2.name: No Signal
2.overview: A tour meant to help guests "disconnect" goes horribly wrong when a hapless guide gets the tour lost in the woods without their phones or GPS. The NPS team must track the stranded hikers before they get overcome by injury and exhaustion.

2.name: Crossfire
2.overview: When Ryan's confidential informant disappears, the investigation pulls a thread that exposes an underground gun smuggling operation tied to the military, a notorious biker gang and Ernie, Jodi's former army partner.

2.name: Jumper
2.overview: When a dead parachutist and thousands of dollars rain down over Crystal Ridge Park, Jodi, Blue, and the team investigate the mysterious jumper and the missing money. But when two young brothers stumble upon the cash, they unknowingly put themselves in the middle of a dangerous mystery.

2.name: No Good Deed
2.overview: When a local man becomes an unlikely hero after rescuing a family from a burning home, his sudden disappearance leads Jodi, Blue and Ryan into a mystery involving his missing wife and a secret he's desperate to protect. Meanwhile, Nora and Meeks investigate a deadly chemical contaminating Cedar River and discover the dumping may be part of something much bigger.

2.name: Legacy
2.overview: When a Civil War reenactment turns deadly after a live round kills a beloved local teacher, Jodi, Blue, Ryan, and the team must determine whether it was a tragic accident or murder. Meanwhile, a determined journalist approaches Ryan with troubling evidence connecting the recent toxic dumping to a pattern of local landowners being forced to sell their property.

2.name: Running Wild
2.overview: When a riderless horse is discovered in Crystal Ridge carrying a large stash of ketamine, Jodi and the team uncover a drug operation that hits dangerously close to home. Meanwhile, Ryan digs deeper into Olivia's investigation and discovers a troubling pattern connecting poisoned land, suspicious sales, and the people profiting from them.

2.name: Frozen
2.overview: When a beloved local chef is found murdered inside the walk-in freezer at Peaks and Valley, Jodi and the team follow a trail of evidence into Crystal Ridge, where a mysterious recluse may hold the key to what happened. Meanwhile, Jodi faces a frightening possibility when a lump discovered on Blue's neck could threaten their future together.

2.name: Broken Vows
2.overview: When a bride-to-be disappears days before her wedding, leaving behind a bloodstained kayak, Jodi and the team race to find her as suspicion falls on an obsessive ex-boyfriend. Meanwhile, Ryan's investigation into the poisoned land takes a major turn when he uncovers a mysterious company buying properties throughout the county.

2.name: Something to Gain
2.overview: When a woman disappears while scattering her husband's ashes in Crystal Ridge, Jodi, Blue, and the team race to find her and uncover a sinister plot behind her disappearance. Meanwhile, Ryan and Olivia's investigation turns deadly when a local landowner is murdered, and someone makes a violent attempt to silence them.

2.name: No Retreat
2.overview: When a key figure in Olivia's investigation is found murdered at an isolated corporate retreat, Jodi, Blue, and the team face a mansion full of suspects as they race to uncover who killed him and why. As the investigation closes in on the truth behind the poisoned land, Ryan discovers the conspiracy reaches far closer to home than he ever imagined.

overview: National Park Investigator Jodi Larsen and a lost dog named Blue team up to solve mysteries in the wilderness, forging an unexpected bond amidst danger and healing.
title: Blue Skies
